thread:
maya: Quick sync  we're scheduling a staged deprecation for the v1 streaming payload and embedding alias fallback. Need owners for playbook, snippets, redirects, and CI smoke tests.
jon: Can you list the exact user-visible changes so we can update examples and changelogs? :mag_right:
maya: Short list: (1) v1 streaming will stop emitting partial-token deltas for rwd-* models; switch consumers to v2 streaming shape (`json-chunks`). (2) Embedding aliases will be remapped (example: `embed-legacy` -> `models.embed-v2`).
elaine: I can own JS + Python snippet edits. I'll draft minimal streaming -> v2 snippets and a tiny embed example.
samir: From infra/QA: we need a docs smoke that runs each snippet against the canary endpoint and asserts no 4xx and first-chunk latency < 500ms. Suggest `docs/smoke/stream_migration.sh` calling `scripts/run_snippet`.
sean: Also add a short migration checklist in the playbook: snippet update, redirect rules, in-page banner, SDK runtime warning, changelog entry, smoke test. I'll add the CI job yaml once snippets land.
maya: docs-bot: create the deprecation PR checklist template and add a pointer to the migration playbook path.
docs-bot: Checklist created at `deprecations/staged_streaming_migration.md` :white_check_mark:
jon: Timeline proposal: snippets draft by Thu EOD, PRs by Mon, smoke green Wed, public notice Fri. Tag me `@jon` in PRs for review.
elaine: Note for SDKs: emit a runtime deprecation warning when v1 streaming params are used and include a link to the playbook. We'll include a small changelog blurb in releases.
samir: I'll coordinate canary runs and reserve a small Dedicated window for smoke tests. Also will add a simple harness that hits both alias and direct model ids.
maya: I'll open a meta PR that links sub-PRs and includes the checklist + a short alias->replacement table with rough cost delta. Ping here if you want to split snippet ownership. :thumbsup:
